6:1: Hamd belongs to Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and made the darknesses and the light; then those who disbelieve hold (others) equal to their Rabb.
6:2: It is He Who created you from clay, then decreed a term. And a determined term is in His presence. Then you doubt.
6:3: He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth. He knows your secret and your open, and He knows what you earn.
6:4: No verse comes to them from the verses of their Rabb but that they turn away from it.
6:5: When the truth came to them, they denied it. The news of what they used to mock will come to them.
6:6: Did they not see how many generations We destroyed before them? We had established them on the earth with opportunities We did not give you; We had sent down torrential rain upon them from the sky and made rivers flow beneath them. Then We destroyed them because of their sins, and after them We raised another generation.
6:7: Even if We had sent down to you a book written on paper and they touched it with their hands, those who disbelieve would still have said: 'This is nothing but clear magic.'
6:8: And they said: 'If only an angel had been sent down to him!' If We had sent down an angel, the matter would certainly have been decreed, then they would not be given respite.
6:9: And if We had made him an angel, We would certainly have made him a man, and We would have obscured for them that (which) they obscure.
6:10: And certainly, messengers before you were also mocked, but that which they mocked enveloped those who mocked.
6:11: Say: Walk upon the earth, then see how the end of the deniers was.
6:12: Say: 'To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth?' Say: 'To Allah.' He has prescribed mercy upon Himself. He will certainly gather you to the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. Those who have lost their souls, they do not believe.
6:13: And to Him belongs whatever rests in the night and the day. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
6:14: Say: 'Shall I take as protector other than Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who feeds and is not fed?' Say: 'Indeed, I was commanded to be the first of those who become Muslims.' And never be of those who associate partners.
6:15: Say: Indeed, if I disobey my Rabb, I fear the punishment of a great day.
6:16: Whoever has the punishment averted from him on that Day, He has indeed had mercy on him, and that is the clear salvation.
6:17: And if Allah touches you with harm, there is none to remove it but He; and if He touches you with good, He is capable of all things.
6:18: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Possessor of judgment and wisdom, All-Aware of everything.
6:19: Say: 'What thing is greatest in testimony?' Say: 'Allah. He is a witness between me and you. And this Quran was revealed to me that I may warn you with it and whomever it reaches. Do you truly testify that there are other gods with Allah?' Say: 'I do not testify.' Say: 'He is only one God, and indeed I am free of that which you associate as partners.'
6:20: Those to whom We gave the Book recognize it as they recognize their own sons. Those who have lost their souls, they do not believe.
6:21: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah or denies His verses? Indeed, the unjust will not attain salvation.
6:22: And on that Day We will gather them all together, then We will say to those who associated partners: 'Where are your partners whom you used to claim?'
6:23: Then their plea was nothing but that they said: 'We swear by Allah, our Rabb, that we were not those who associated partners.'
6:24: Look how they lied against their own souls, and what they used to invent strayed away from them.
6:25: And among them are those who listen to you. We have placed coverings over their hearts preventing them from understanding it, and in their ears deafness. Even if they see every verse, they do not believe in it. Until when they come to you, they argue with you. Those who disbelieve say: 'This is nothing but tales of the ancients.'
6:26: And they forbid from it and turn away from it. And they destroy none but themselves, and they are not aware.
6:27: If only you could see when they are stopped over the Fire! They say: If only we were returned, and we would not deny the verses of our Rabb and we would be of the believers.
6:28: Nay, what they used to conceal before has appeared to them. And if they were returned, they would certainly return to what they were forbidden from. Indeed, they are liars.
6:29: And they said: It is nothing but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected.
6:30: If only you could see when they are stopped in the presence of their Rabb! Allah says: 'Was this not the truth?' And they say: 'Yes, we swear by our Rabb, it was.' Allah says: 'Then taste the punishment because you disbelieved!'
6:31: Those who denied meeting Allah have surely suffered loss; until when the Hour comes upon them suddenly, they say: 'Woe to us for the shortcomings we committed regarding it!'
6:32: The life of this world is nothing but play and amusement, and the abode of the Hereafter is better for those who fear (Allah); will you still not use your reason?
6:33: We certainly know that what they say grieves you. Indeed, they do not deny you, but the unjust reject the verses of Allah.
6:34: And certainly, messengers before you were also denied. They were patient with being denied and they suffered harm until Our help came to them. There is none who can change the words of Allah. And certainly, there has come to you of the news of the messengers.
6:35: And if their turning away has been heavy on you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel in the earth or a ladder to the sky and bring them a verse, (do so). If Allah had willed, He would have gathered them upon guidance. So do not ever be of the ignorant.
6:36: Only those who hear respond. As for the dead, Allah will resurrect them, then to Him they will be returned.
6:37: And they said: 'If only a verse had been sent down to him from his Rabb!' Say: 'Indeed, Allah is capable of sending down a verse, but most of them do not know.'
6:38: There is no creature on the earth and no bird flying with its two wings that are not communities like you. We have not neglected anything in the Book. Then to their Rabb they will be gathered.
6:39: Those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb in darknesses. Whomever Allah wills, He leads astray; and whomever He wills, He sets him on a straight path.
6:40: Say: 'Have you seen? If the punishment of Allah comes to you or the Hour comes to you, would you supplicate to other than Allah, if you are truthful?'
6:41: Nay, to Him alone you would supplicate, and if He willed, He would remove that for which you supplicated to Him, and you would forget what you associate as partners.
6:42: And certainly, We had sent messengers to communities before you as well. Then We seized them with distress and hardship so that perhaps they would plead.
6:43: Thus, when Our severity came to them, should they not have pleaded and implored? But their hearts hardened, and Satan adorned for them what they were doing.
6:44: Thus, when they forgot that which had been reminded to them, We opened upon them the doors of everything, until when they rejoiced in what was given to them, We seized them suddenly, and they at once became ones falling into despair.
6:45: Thus, the root of the wrongdoing people was cut off. Praise belongs to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
6:46: Say: 'Have you seen? If Allah takes away your hearing and your eyes and seals your hearts, which deity other than Allah will bring it to you? Look how We explain the verses in various ways, then they turn away.'
6:47: Say: 'Have you seen, if the punishment of Allah comes to you suddenly or openly, will anyone be destroyed except the wrongdoing people?'
6:48: We do not send the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. Whoever believes and reforms, then there is no fear upon them, and they will not grieve.
6:49: To those who deny Our verses, punishment will touch them because of their committing transgression.
6:50: Say: 'I do not say to you that the treasures of Allah are with me, nor do I know the unseen (ghayb), and I do not say to you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me.' Say: 'Are the blind and the seeing equal? Do you not reflect at all?'
6:51: Warn with it those who fear that they will be gathered to their Rabb. For them, there is no protector and no intercessor other than Him.
6:52: Do not drive away those who call upon their Rabb morning and evening, desiring His Face. Nothing of their account falls upon you, and nothing of your account falls upon them, such that you should drive them away and thus be of the wrongdoers.
6:53: And thus We tested some of them by others so that they would say: 'Did Allah bestow favor upon these among us?' Is Allah not best knowing of those who are grateful?
6:54: When those who believe in Our verses come to you, say: 'Peace be upon you. Your Rabb has prescribed mercy upon Himself. Undoubtedly, whoever among you does evil out of ignorance, then repents after that and reforms, undoubtedly He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.'
6:55: And thus We explain the verses so that the way of the criminals may become clear.
6:56: Say: 'Undoubtedly, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah.' Say: 'I will not follow your desires. In that case, I would have gone astray, and I would not be of the guided ones.'
6:57: Say: 'Undoubtedly, I am upon a clear proof from my Rabb, and you denied it. That which you seek to hasten is not with me. The judgment belongs only to Allah. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders.'
6:58: Say: 'If that which you seek to hasten were with me, the matter between me and you would certainly have been concluded, and Allah knows the wrongdoers best.'
6:59: The keys of the unseen (ghayb) are with Him; no one knows them except Him. He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls, and there is no grain in the darknesses of the earth, and nothing wet and nothing dry, but that it is in a clear Book.
6:60: It is He who causes you to pass away by night and knows what you have acquired by day. Then He raises you up in it so that a designated term may be fulfilled. Then to Him is your return, then He will inform you of what you used to do.
6:61: He is the Irresistible over His servants, and He sends guardians over you, until when death comes to one of you, Our messengers cause him to pass away, and they do not fail.
6:62: Then they were returned to Allah, their true Mawla. Pay attention, the judgment is His, and He is the swiftest of reckoners.
6:63: Say: "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and the sea? You call upon Him humbly and secretly: 'By oath, if You save us from this, we will certainly be among the grateful.'"
6:64: Say: "Allah rescues you from it and from every distress, then you associate partners."
6:65: Say: 'He is able to send upon you a punishment from above you or from beneath your feet, or to divide you into sects and make some of you taste the severity of others.' Look how We explain the verses, so that perhaps they may understand.
6:66: Your people denied it, and it is the truth. Say: 'You are not a guardian over them.'
6:67: For every news there is a settled time, and you will soon know.
6:68: When you see those who dive deep regarding Our verses, turn away from them until they dive into another talk. If Satan makes you forget, do not sit with the wrongdoing people after remembering.
6:69: There is nothing of their account upon those who beware, but it is a reminder so that perhaps they may beware.
6:70: Leave those who take their religion as play and amusement and whom the life of this world has deceived. And give advice with it so that a soul may not be delivered to destruction because of what it has earned. It has no protector and no intercessor besides Allah. Even if it were to give every kind of ransom, it would not be accepted from it. Those are the ones who are delivered to destruction because of what they have earned. For them there is a drink of boiling water and a painful punishment, because they were disbelieving.
6:71: Say: "Shall we pray to things besides Allah that neither benefit us nor harm us? And shall we be turned back on our heels after Allah has guided us? Shall we be like the one whom the devils have confused and led astray on earth, while his companions call him to the right path saying, 'Come to us!'?" Say: "Undoubtedly, the guidance of Allah is the very guidance itself, and we have been commanded to submit to the Rabb of the worlds."
6:72: And establish the salah and beware of Him, and He is the One to whom you will be gathered.
6:73: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth with truth. The day He says 'Be', it is. His word is the truth. The day the Horn is blown, the sovereignty is His. He is the Knower of the unseen (ghayb) and the witnessed (shahadah). He is the Wise, the All-Aware.
6:74: And when Abraham said to his father Azar: "Do you take idols as deities? Undoubtedly, I see you and your people in clear error."
6:75: And thus We were showing Abraham the dominion (malakut) of the heavens and the earth so that he would be of those who have certainty.
6:76: When the night fell upon him, he saw a star. He said, 'This is my Rabb.' When it set, he said, 'I do not like those that set.'
6:77: When he saw the moon rising, he said, 'This is my Rabb.' When it set, he said, 'If my Rabb does not guide me, I will definitely be of the people who go astray.'
6:78: When he saw the sun rising, he said, 'This is my Rabb, this is bigger.' When it set, he said, 'O my people, I am free from that which you associate as partners.'
6:79: Undoubtedly, I have turned my face toward the One who created the heavens and the earth, as a hanif, and I am not of those who associate partners.
6:80: His people argued with him. He said: Do you argue with me about Allah while He has guided me? Unless my Rabb wills something, I do not fear the things you associate as partners. My Rabb has encompassed all things with knowledge. Will you still not reflect?
6:81: How should I fear what you have associated as partners, whereas you do not fear associating as partners with Allah things concerning which He has sent down no proof to you? Then which of the two groups is more worthy of security, if you know?
6:82: Those who believe and do not mix their faith with wrongdoing, it is they for whom there is security, and they are the ones who are rightly guided.
6:83: And this is Our proof that We gave to Abraham against his people. We raise in degrees whom We will. Indeed, your Rabb is al-Hakim, al-Alim.
6:84: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob; all We guided. And previously We had guided Noah as well, and from his offspring David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, and Aaron - and thus do We reward the muhsinun.
6:85: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias too, and all are of the righteous.
6:86: And Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah, and Lot too. All We favored over the worlds.
6:87: And from their fathers, their offspring, and their brothers too; We chose them and guided them to a straight path.
6:88: This is the guidance of Allah. He guides with it whom He wills of His servants. If they had associated partners, everything they did would have come to naught.
6:89: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Book, judgment, and prophethood. If these disbelieve in it, We entrust it to a people who are not disbelievers in it.
6:90: Those are the ones whom Allah guided. So follow their guidance. Say: In return for this, I do not ask of you any fee.
6:91: They did not appraise Allah with true appraisal. Because they said: Allah has not sent down anything to any human being. Say: Who sent down the Book that Moses brought as a light and guidance for people? You make it into sheets of paper, showing part of it and concealing much. And you were taught things that neither you nor your forefathers knew. Say: Allah. Then leave them playing in the falsehood into which they have plunged.
6:92: And this is a blessed Book that We have sent down, confirming that which was before it, and that you may warn the Mother of Cities and those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they maintain their salah.
6:93: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah, or who says 'It has been revealed to me' while nothing has been revealed to him, and who says 'I will send down like what Allah has sent down'? If you could only see those wrongdoers when they are in the agonies of death, with the angels stretching forth their hands: 'Discharge your souls; today you will be recompensed with the humiliating punishment because of what you used to say against Allah unjustly and because you used to show arrogance against His verses.'
6:94: And by oath, you have come to Us alone, just as We created you the first time, and you have left behind your backs the things We gave you. And We do not see with you your intercessors whom you claimed were partners for you. By oath, the bond between you has been severed, and what you used to claim has vanished from you.
6:95: Indeed, Allah is the cleaver of the grain and the seed; He brings forth the living from the dead, and He is the bringer forth of the dead from the living. This is Allah; how then are you turned away?
6:96: He is the cleaver of the daybreak; He made the night a rest, and the sun and the moon a reckoning. This is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
6:97: And He is the One who made the stars for you that you may find your way with them in the darknesses of the land and the sea. Truly We make the verses detailed for a people who know.
6:98: And He is the One who created you from a single soul, then there is a place of settlement and a place of custody. Truly We have explained the verses for a people who understand.
6:99: And He is the One who sends down water from the sky. With it We brought forth the plant of everything. From it We brought forth greenery; from it We bring forth grains piled upon one another. And from date palms, clusters hanging low from their spathes, and vineyards, and olives and pomegranates, resembling and not resembling. Look at its fruit when it bears fruit and at its ripening. Truly in these are signs for a people who believe.
6:100: They made the jinn partners to Allah, whereas He created them. And without knowledge they fabricated sons and daughters for Him. He is exalted and free from what they describe.
6:101: He is the Originator in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and how can there be a child for Him when there has been no spouse for Him, and He created all things, and He knows all things.
6:102: This is Allah, your Rabb. There is no deity except Him. He is the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He is a Trustee over all things.
6:103: Eyes cannot perceive Him, but He perceives the eyes. He is al-Latif, the All-Aware.
6:104: Indeed, clear proofs have come to you from your Rabb; whoever sees, it is for his own benefit, and whoever turns blind, it is to his own detriment, and I am not a keeper over you.
6:105: And thus We turn about the verses so that they may say, 'You have studied,' and that We may explain it for a people who know.
6:106: Follow what has been revealed to you from your Rabb; there is no deity except Him, and turn away from the polytheists.
6:107: If Allah had willed, they would not have associated partners, and We have not made you a keeper over them, nor are you a trustee over them.
6:108: Do not revile those who supplicate to other than Allah, lest they revile Allah out of hostility and ignorance. Thus We have adorned for every community their deeds. Then their return is to their Rabb, and He will inform them of what they used to do.
6:109: And they swore by Allah with the utmost strength of their oaths that if a verse came to them, they would surely believe in it. Say: Verses are only with Allah. And what will inform you that truly when it (the verse) comes, they will not believe?
6:110: We turn their hearts and eyes just as they did not bring faith with it the first time, and We leave them wandering blindly in their transgression.
6:111: And even if We had sent down the angels to them, and the dead had spoken to them, and We had gathered all things face to face before them, they would not have believed unless Allah willed; but most of them do not know.
6:112: And thus We made for every prophet enemies from among the devils of mankind and jinn; some of them whisper adorned speech to others to deceive. If your Rabb had willed, they would not have done it. So leave them alone with what they invent.
6:113: And so that the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter may incline toward it, and that they may be pleased with it, and that they may continue to commit what they are committing.
6:114: Shall I seek a judge other than Allah? Whereas He has sent down to you the Book in detail. Those to whom We gave the Book know that it has been sent down from your Rabb in truth. So do not ever be of the doubters.
6:115: The word of your Rabb has been completed in truth and justice. There is none to change His words. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
6:116: If you obey most of those on the earth, they will lead you astray from the way of Allah; they follow only conjecture and they do nothing but guess.
6:117: Indeed, your Rabb knows best who strays from His way, and He knows best those who are on the right path.
6:118: If you believe in His verses, eat of that over which the name of Allah has been mentioned.
6:119: What is the matter with you that you do not eat of that over which the name of Allah has been mentioned? Whereas He has explained to you in detail what He has made unlawful for you, except that to which you are compelled; and indeed, many mislead by their own desires without knowledge. Indeed, your Rabb knows best the transgressors.
6:120: Leave the open of sin and the secret of it. Indeed, those who earn sin will be recompensed for what they used to earn.
6:121: Do not eat of that over which the name of Allah has not been mentioned, and indeed it is fisq, and the devils inspire their friends to dispute with you; and if you obey them, you will surely be mushriks.
6:122: Is the one who was dead and We gave him life and gave him a light with which he walks among the people like the one who is in darknesses from which he cannot emerge? Thus has been made fair-seeming to the disbelievers what they used to do.
6:123: And thus We have made in every city the greatest of its criminals (its notables) to plot therein. Yet they plot only against themselves, and they do not perceive.
6:124: And when a verse comes to them, they say: "We will never believe until we are given the like of what was given to the messengers of Allah." Allah knows best where He places His messengership. There will afflict those who committed crimes a humiliation before Allah and a severe punishment because of what they used to plot.
6:125: Whomever Allah wills to guide to the right path, He opens his breast to Islam. And whomever He wills to lead astray, He makes his breast tight and constricted, as if he were climbing into the sky. Thus Allah places defilement upon those who do not believe.
6:126: And this is the straight path of your Rabb. We have explained the verses in detail for a people who reflect.
6:127: For them is the home of peace with their Rabb, and He is their wali (protector) because of what they used to do.
6:128: On that day We will gather them all: O company of jinn, you have misled many of mankind. Their allies among mankind will say: Our Rabb, some of us benefited from others, and we have reached our appointed term that You determined for us. Allah will say: The Fire is your residence, abiding eternally therein, except as Allah wills. Indeed, your Rabb is Wise, Knowing.
6:129: And thus We make some of the wrongdoers close to others because of what they used to earn.
6:130: O company of jinn and mankind! Did there not come to you messengers from among you, reciting to you My verses and warning you of the meeting of this day of yours? They said: 'We testify against ourselves.' And the worldly life deceived them, and they testified against themselves that they were disbelievers.
6:131: This is because your Rabb would not destroy cities with injustice while their people were unaware.
6:132: For each there are degrees from what they did, and your Rabb is not unaware of what they do.
6:133: Your Rabb is the Possessor of mercy, Self-Sufficient. If He wills, He can take you away and appoint whatever He wills after you in your place, just as He produced you from the offspring of another people.
6:134: Indeed, what you are promised will surely come, and you are not ones who can frustrate (render powerless).
6:135: Say: O my people, act according to your position; indeed, I too am acting. Soon you will know for whom the ultimate end of the home will be.
6:136: And they assigned to Allah a share of the crops and livestock that He created, and they said according to their conjecture: 'This is for Allah, and this is for our partners.' But what belongs to their partners does not reach Allah, while what belongs to Allah reaches their partners. How evil is the judgment they make!
6:137: And thus their partners made fair-seeming to many of the mushriks the killing of their children, in order to ruin them and to obscure their religion for them. If Allah had willed, they would not have done it. So leave them and their fabrications.
6:138: And they said: 'These are untouchable livestock and crops; none shall eat them except whom we will,' according to their claim. And [there are] animals whose backs are forbidden, and animals over which they do not mention the name of Allah, fabricating against Him. He will recompense them for the fabrications they made.
6:139: They said: 'What is in the bellies of these animals is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our spouses.' But if it is stillborn, then they are partners in it.
6:140: Those who killed their children foolishly, without knowledge, and forbade what Allah had provided them as sustenance, fabricating against Allah, have certainly lost. They went astray and were not guided.
6:141: And He is the One Who created gardens trellised and untrellised, and date palms, and crops of diverse produce, and olives and pomegranates similar and dissimilar. Eat of its fruit when it bears fruit, and give its due on the day of its harvest. And do not be wasteful. For He does not love the wasteful.
6:142: And of the animals are burden-bearers and small animals; eat of what Allah has provided for you as sustenance, and do not follow the footsteps of Satan, for indeed he is a clear enemy to you.
6:143: Eight pairs: two of the sheep and two of the goats. Say: 'Is it the two males He has forbidden, or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain?' Inform me with knowledge if you are truthful.
6:144: And of the camels two, and of the cattle two. Say: 'Is it the two males He has forbidden, or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain?' Or were you witnesses when Allah enjoined this upon you? Who can be more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah to mislead people without knowledge? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
6:145: Say: 'In that which is revealed to me, I do not find anything made unlawful to an eater who would eat it, except carrion, or outpoured blood, or the flesh of swine—for it is an impurity—or an animal slaughtered in sin in the name of other than Allah.' But whoever is forced by necessity, without desiring excess and without exceeding the limit, undoubtedly your Rabb is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
6:146: And to the Jews We made unlawful every animal with claws; and We made unlawful to them their internal fats, except what is on the backs of cattle and sheep, or in their entrails, or what is mixed with bone. That is the penalty We gave them because of their transgression. And undoubtedly, We are truthful.
6:147: If they deny you, say: 'Your Rabb is the possessor of vast mercy, and His punishment will not be turned back from the criminal people.'
6:148: Those who associate partners will say: 'If Allah had willed, neither we nor our forefathers would have associated partners, and we would not have made anything unlawful.' Those before them likewise denied, until they tasted Our punishment. Say: 'Do you have with you any knowledge that you can bring out to us? You follow nothing but conjecture, and you do nothing but guess.'
6:149: Say: For Allah is the supreme proof; if He had willed, He would have guided you all to the right path.
6:150: Say: "Bring your witnesses who will testify that Allah made this unlawful." If they testify, do not testify with them, and do not follow the desires of those who deny Our verses and do not believe in the Hereafter; they equate others with their Rabb.
6:151: Say: Come, let me recite what your Rabb has made unlawful to you: Do not associate anything with Him; do good to parents; do not kill your children out of poverty—We provide for you and for them; do not approach immoralities, secret or open; do not kill the soul that Allah has forbidden, except by right. These He enjoins upon you so that you may reason.
6:152: And do not approach the property of the orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches the age of maturity; and give full measure and weight with justice. We do not burden any soul beyond what it can bear. When you speak, be just, even if it be a relative. And fulfill the covenant of Allah. These He enjoins upon you so that you may take heed.
6:153: And undoubtedly, this is My straight path, so follow it; and do not follow [other] paths, lest they separate you from His path; these He has commanded you.
6:154: Then We gave Moses the Book, to complete [the blessing] upon those who do good, and as an explanation of everything, and as a guidance and a mercy.
6:155: And this is a blessed Book that We have sent down, so follow it and beware, so that you may be shown mercy.
6:156: Lest you should say: "The Book was only sent down to two communities before us, and we were indeed unaware of their learning."
6:157: Or lest you should say: "If the Book had been sent down to us, we would have been more guided than them." Now there has come to you a clear proof from your Rabb, a guidance, and a mercy. Who then is more unjust than one who denies the verses of Allah and turns away from them? We will recompense those who turn away from Our verses with the worst of punishment because of their turning away.
6:158: Do they wait for anything except that the angels should come to them, or your Rabb should come, or some of the signs of your Rabb should come? The day some of the signs of your Rabb come, its faith will not benefit a soul that did not believe before or did not earn any good in its faith. Say: Wait, we too are waiting.
6:159: Undoubtedly, as for those who divided their religion and broke up into sects, you are not of them in anything. Their affair is only with Allah. Then Allah will inform them of what they used to do.
6:160: Whoever comes with a good deed, for him there is ten times the like thereof; and whoever comes with an evil deed, he will only be recompensed with the like of it, and they will not be wronged.
6:161: Say: "Undoubtedly, my Rabb has guided me to a straight path, an upright religion, the hanif religion of Abraham; he was not of the mushriks."
6:162: Say: Undoubtedly, my salah, my rites of worship, my life, and my death are for Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
6:163: He has no partner; with this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims.
6:164: Say: “Shall I seek a rabb other than Allah, while He is the Rabb of everything? Every soul earns only against itself. No bearer of burdens carries the burden of another. Then to your Rabb is your return; He will inform you of the things wherein you used to differ.”
6:165: It is He who made you successors of the earth and raised some of you above others by degrees, in order to test you with what He gave you; undoubtedly your Rabb is swift in retribution, and undoubtedly He is certainly forgiving, most merciful.
